description:
Fetch and parse an XML sitemap, sitemap index, or plaintext URL list. Returns URL entries (with lastmod/changefreq/priority) or child sitemap locations.

upAPI operation `sitemap-parse.get` (SEO tools). Costs 1 unit of monthly quota per call.

url.description: Sitemap URL (usually /sitemap.xml or a sitemap index)
url.title: Url

name: sitemap_parse_get
title: Parse Sitemap
